t: Estonia declared independence in 1918 and won it in the War of Independence, confirmed by the Treaty of Tartu in 1920.
Occupied by the Soviet Union in 1940, it was restored in 1991 as the legal continuation of the pre-war republic.
Since 2004 it has been a member of the EU and NATO, known worldwide for e-government and internet voting.
dyk: In 2007 Estonia became the first country to allow online voting nationwide in a parliamentary election, using its national electronic ID card.
ev: The Salvation Committee declares the Republic of Estonia on 24 February
The Treaty of Tartu ends the War of Independence
Konstantin Päts declares a state of emergency and rules by decree
The Soviet Union occupies and annexes Estonia
The Baltic Way human chain links Tallinn, Riga and Vilnius
